description.name: Entry
description.text: One single attack (31.00 or 33.00 each) capped at 199,999 based on MAG and MND. Grants [Extra Mode], [Damage Cap +20000], [Extra Mode: Arc], [Instant ATB 1] to user. Grants [Attach Holy 3 with Secondary Stacking] or [Attach Water 3 with Secondary Stacking].

description.name: Extra Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses.

description.name: Extra Mode: Arc
description.text: Increases Holy/Water ability damage by 10/20/30/40/50% at Attach Holy/Water level 1/2/3/4/5, Holy/Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, Holy/Water abilities trigger 3 additional times (max 1), Holy/Water abilities have Quick Cast, removed if user hasn't [Extra Mode]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Secondary Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 5, up to Attach Holy 5

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Secondary Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 5, up to Attach Water 5
